contract.PDF_anchor_requirement: Existing preserved PDF client/year/SHA/bytes/page_count/page_labels/export_provenance descriptor must match exactly; content must still hash to PDF SHA on import and read; no PDF bytes rewritten or tax case created
contract.canonicalization: UTF8 JSON sorted object keys recursively; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false; finite structural integers only; original candidate and geometry evidence retained as JSON strings to preserve original float token representations
contract.independent_parser: Strict English split dollars/explicit2cents or whole explicit decimal, French exact grouping with explicit2cents, and2023 original drawn-box token grouping. No source totals/CSV value assists parsing; no missing cents or blank amount becomes zero.
contract.ownership_requirement: Prior verified native printed owner reference plus archived identity/year evidence; exact name or unique full private identity continuity closure is distinguished and held diagnostics excluded
contract.printed_cents: nullable canonical signed base10 integer string derived only from explicit printed money tokens; never native wire units
contract.printed_decimal: nullable signed fixed2 decimal string; exactly printed_cents divided by100 with two explicit decimal places; zero canonicalized to0.00
contract.source_comparison_state: exact existing PDF export_provenance.figure_comparisons value for this line, retained as comparison evidence only
contract.state_derivation: No candidates -> printed_line_not_located; any held candidate or multiple distinct printed amounts -> held_ambiguous_printed_amount; invalid explicit token parse or disagreement with candidate amount -> held_invalid_printed_money_token; all identified blank -> identified_printed_blank; otherwise one unique unambiguous independently token-parsed amount -> single_distinct_printed_amount. Blank, missing and held states always retain null decimal/cents.
